summary: PR #613 adds a draft->submitted->approved/rejected approval-status flow to pms_time_entries (new enum + approvedById/approvedAt/rejectionReason columns) plus two new designer-wise construction reports (designer-approval-status, work-analysis), extending PR #597's construction-reports-service.ts rather than duplicating it. The schema change and hand-written migration (drizzle/0268_pms_time_entry_approval_flow.sql) are additive only, numbered correctly against _journal.json with no collision, and follow the established DO $$/ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pattern. Service-layer logic in pms-time-service.ts is correct: submitTimeEntry enforces entry ownership and a draft-only precondition, reviewTimeEntry enforces submitted-only precondition and blocks self-approval, and the new /api/pms/time-entries/[id]/{submit,approve,reject} routes correctly gate approve/reject behind requireRole(dbUser, 'manager') using the real ROLE_RANK hierarchy (submit is owner-only, enforced in the service). The two new report functions correctly scope every query by orgId and derive issueIds/userIds from already org-scoped rows before use, so no cross-tenant leakage. The report dispatcher route correctly narrows on the new work-analysis report name for its extra dateFrom/dateTo params. Tests cover the state machine, self-approval block, route-level access control (403 for member, 200 for manager), and the new pure aggregators. No .github/workflows/** files are touched by this diff. The bulk of the diff stat is PROGRESS.md history churn (prior task's stale content replaced with this task's own section), which is inert. This is a clean, well-scoped, correctly-isolated feature addition; tier2 classification is expected given the schema/migration touch, so it is ready for human sign-off, not autonomous merge.
